goal: Generate a coverage map for Starbucks locations in China that can be used directly on brand websites, franchise events, and internal sharing meetings.

brand.name: Starbucks
brand.logo_description: White circle with green long-haired twin-tailed siren silhouette, small text STARBUCKS COFFEE along the bottom edge
brand.brand_color: Starbucks green #00704A as primary, cream white as base, dark brown as accent

scope.base_map_style: Simplified provincial borders, low-saturation fill from pale cyan-green to cream white, no district-level roads

by_type: High-traffic transit hubs, hospitals, and special locations: 180
stores.highlight_cities: Shanghai, Beijing, Shenzhen, Guangzhou, Chengdu, Hangzhou, Wuhan, Nanjing, Chongqing, Xi'an

marker_design.shapes: Large circle = Reserve/Roastery, medium circle = standard store, small triangle = special location, small square = partner-operated
marker_design.rule: Size corresponds to store tier; not intended to be geospatially exact

content: In China mainland market for over 30 years
280+ new stores opened in the past year
Top 5 cities: Shanghai, Beijing, Shenzhen, Guangzhou, Chengdu

items: Large dark-green circle: Starbucks Reserve / Roastery
Small triangle: Transit hub / hospital / scenic spot

extras: Bottom franchise strip: This map is a brand coverage overview; actual store policies subject to local regulations and HQ disclosures

must_keep: Point density denser in east, sparser in west — intuitive
Use only Starbucks brand color palette
Legend must map to marker shapes
Highlight cities must be instantly scannable
avoid: Evenly scattered points across every province
One-to-one match with real GIS grids
